blocking_finding.issue: R1 declares a 6.5 GB memory reservation/max and 6.1 GB MemoryHigh, but the controller computes MemoryHigh = reserve - min(1 GB, reserve/10), which yields 5.85 GB for the declared 6.5 GB reserve. The contract and actual admission would therefore disagree.
blocking_finding.consequence: Do not launch using the R1 resource declaration as if its 6.1 GB MemoryHigh were applied. The actual 5.85 GB threshold would trigger reclaim earlier than declared and may cause unnecessary pressure/throttling; the separate 6.5 GB hard maximum is unchanged.
blocking_finding.smallest_correction: Root reports the R2 admission will use a 6.8 GB reservation/hard max; the controller formula then yields 6.12 GB MemoryHigh. Bind those R2 values in an immutable successor/admission receipt and refresh the aggregate-parent-capacity gate before launch. Keep the source/recipe argv unchanged.

resources_otherwise_reviewed.aggregate_capacity_interpretation: Root reports the refreshed parent plus proposed 6.8 GB attempt max remains below 18 GB high; root retains the fresh live aggregate/GPU launch gate.
